session_name: Session 4: 大模型安全 (12月27日 09:00-11:00)
session_chair: 论坛主席：刘东瑞 (上海人工智能实验室)      董胤蓬 (清华大学)
session_desc: 随着大模型及智能体在科研与产业中的广泛部署，其安全可信问题日益突出，已成为人工智能健康发展的关键挑战。本论坛聚焦大模型安全的前沿研究与关键问题，邀请来自中关村实验室、南京大学、中国科学院计算技术研究所与清华大学的四位学者，围绕大模型安全失效机理分析、AI智能体劫持与权限滥用、多模态大模型后门攻击与防御、AI研发自动化引发的“智能爆炸”风险等议题展开报告，涵盖安全假设分析、智能体攻防、后门检测与缓解以及前沿AI风险评估等核心方向。论坛旨在促进大模型安全领域的学术交流与合作，推动构建更加安全、可靠、可控的大模型与智能体系统。

speaker.name: 王嘉凯
speaker.desc: 中关村实验室副研究员、博士生导师

session_list.title: 大模型安全失效分析：等价判定假设视角
session_list.desc: 大模型已经成为当前人工智能的最核心技术之一，全面赋能科研、产业发展。然而大模型仍然存在多种安全风险，需要不断增强其安全能力。尽管已经有很多安全问题和安全防护策略被提出，但是有一个问题始终值得探讨：当前条件下大模型安全为何会失效？本报告中，我们提出一个观点，应对大模型安全失效风险要从其隐含的关键假设出发，才能够更好的理解和处理其应用问题。为此，我们结合团队近期工作介绍了一类等价判定假设问题，并对未来风险应对做出了展望和建议。

speaker.name: 吴昊
speaker.desc: 南京大学特聘研究员、博士生导师

session_list.title: Hijacking AI Agents: From Decision Manipulation to Action Rebinding
session_list.desc: AI agents act across applications and services with authority delegated by the user. We investigate how attackers turn this authority toward unauthorized operations by manipulating where actions take effect and what counts as permission. In Android GUI agents, Action Rebinding exploits the interval between observation and execution. A malicious application switches the foreground before a correctly planned interaction is delivered, redirecting it to a sensitive operation in another app without holding the corresponding permissions. The agent’s task-recovery behavior allows repeated rebindings to form multi-step attacks. Attackers can also manipulate authorization before execution. Cooperating third-party skills plant a false approval claim in persistent workspace guidance and use it to justify an unauthorized operation. The working agent and permission reviewer can then accept the same fabricated premise, allowing the operation to pass review. These studies show that protecting an agent’s delegated authority requires verifying both who authorized an operation and whether its execution reaches the intended target.

speaker.name: 张杰
speaker.desc: 中国科学院计算技术研究所研究员、博士生导师、国家级青年人才

session_list.title: 多模态大模型后门攻击与防御
session_list.desc: 随着多模态大模型的快速发展，其安全可信问题引发广泛关注。报告将介绍课题组在多模态大模型后门攻防方面的最新进展，包括基于句法触发器的高隐蔽后门攻击方法、基于同化现象的统一防御框架（涵盖后门检测、定位与缓解），基于注意力动态异常发现的后门防御方法、基于视觉注意力熵的后门模型检测方法以及模型后门反演方法。最后，报告将对未来研究方向与发展趋势进行总结与展望。

speaker.name: Sören Mindermann
speaker.desc: 清华大学人工智能学院助理教授

session_list.title: What if automating AI R&D triggers an intelligence explosion?
session_list.desc: In contrast to even last year, AI systems now write most of the code inside the companies that build them. As more of the AI research and development (R&D) pipeline is automated, could AI progress radically accelerate in an “intelligence explosion,” where years of advances are compressed into months or less? Preliminary evidence suggests that it could. We assess this evidence and analyze an intelligence explosion’s potential impacts. AI systems are on track to automate most AI R&D work within a few years, and possibly all of it. If this triggers an intelligence explosion, it could dramatically bring forward AI’s benefits, but also pose extreme risks: capabilities growth could accelerate far beyond what society can keep up with, humanity could lose control over superhuman AI systems, and checks on power within and between states, companies, and branches of government could be severely eroded. Although there remains much uncertainty about these possibilities, the high stakes warrant serious further attention.
